title: USDOT Reconnecting Communities Pilot
description: Federal planning grant funding master planning, feasibility studies, and preliminary design for the two Bluffline priority nodes — Jackson Lakes/West Pensacola and Ferry Pass/UWF. This work will produce the foundational plans needed to advance these nodes toward construction funding.

milestones.title: Grant Announced
milestones.description: $1.2M awarded by USDOT through the Reconnecting Communities Pilot Program.

milestones.title: Grant Agreement Execution
milestones.description: Finalizing the federal grant agreement with USDOT. Full obligation of funds is pending completion of this process — a necessary step before planning work can formally begin.

milestones.title: Program Management & Work Plan
milestones.description: Establishing coordination structure, roles, budget management, and reporting systems for the planning program.

milestones.title: Stakeholder Mapping & Engagement Strategy
milestones.description: Identifying corridor stakeholders and building a public outreach plan that meaningfully reaches communities in West Pensacola and Ferry Pass.

milestones.title: Community Visioning
milestones.description: Public sessions to define shared goals and guiding values for both priority nodes before design decisions are made.

milestones.title: Master Planning & Alternatives Analysis
milestones.description: Studying alignment and design options at both nodes, evaluating tradeoffs, and identifying the preferred path forward — the Locally Preferred Alternative.

milestones.title: Feasibility Studies
milestones.description: Technical analysis of alignment options, utility and ownership constraints, rail interfaces, and waterfront conditions at the two priority nodes.

milestones.title: Preliminary Design
milestones.description: Early engineering drawings establishing preferred alignments, typical sections, and crossing concepts — the foundation for future construction-ready plans.

outputs: Community-endorsed vision and Locally Preferred Alternative for both nodes
Feasibility studies documenting constraints, opportunities, and cost ranges
Preliminary engineering drawings at both priority nodes
Foundation for subsequent construction funding applications
